packages.technicalBoundary: Illustrative clear internal dimensions. Equal area at fixed volume flow/reference basis gives equal mean velocity, not necessarily equal friction. No pressure-loss ratio, code recommendation or hydraulic-diameter sizing equivalence.

packages.technicalBoundary: Ideal mixing at a common pressure, without heat/moisture exchange with surroundings. Humidity ratio and enthalpy are dry-air-mass weighted; volume fraction need not equal dry-air mass fraction. Output is not ventilation compliance or a real equipment diagnosis.
packages.arithmeticLabel: Illustrative or conceptual; not measured performance, equipment diagnosis, design targets or code compliance.

packages.technicalBoundary: Sensible warming at fixed total pressure and fixed humidity ratio, with no moisture exchange. RH decline is not evidence of dehumidification. Concept only, not diagnosis or heating-coil sizing.
packages.arithmeticLabel: Illustrative or conceptual; not measured performance, equipment diagnosis, design targets or code compliance.

packages.technicalBoundary: Illustrative mean cross-sectional velocity; volume flow and area use consistent units/reference basis. 500 and1000FPM are not design targets. A real duct modification may change system airflow; this arithmetic does not predict fan/system behavior.
